summary: Iteration 4: Comprehensive frontend testing of Journal Logging UI with newly added Gym Activity feature. All features working correctly - Journal tab loads with Log & Entries and Trends tabs, Log Today button opens modal with all metrics (Weight, Energy 1-10, Sleep Quality 1-10, Hours Slept, 5 Mood emojis), new Gym Activity with 8 workout types (Weights, Cardio, Yoga, Cycling, Swimming, Sports, Walking, Other), conditional Duration and Intensity (1-10) fields when workout selected. Entries save and display correctly with gym activity shown. Trends tab shows 7-Day Trends with placeholder when <2 entries.

success_rate.frontend: 100% - All Journal and Gym Activity features working
